reference_answer: At the frozen commit GET /api/todos ignores the completed query and Store.List returns all rows ordered by id. A correct patch accepts absent, true and false values; absent retains all rows, true/false select by completed without changing order or stored data, and invalid values return 400. The prepared check fails because both rows are returned for completed=true. The full Go suite should continue passing.
